## AS IS - Current state

### Runtime and language

- **Language**: PHP ^8.4; JavaScript ES modules
- **Framework**: Laravel ^13.0; Livewire ^4.0
- **Runtime**: PHP 8.4 in Laravel Sail (`compose.yaml`); Node.js 20+ (`README.md`)
- **Package managers**: Composer and npm (`composer.json`, `package.json`)
- **Frontend**: Tailwind CSS ^4.1.4, Alpine.js ^3.4.2, DaisyUI ^5.0.28, Vite ^8.0.3

### Tests

| Capability | Tool | Version/evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Runner | Pest | ^5.0 (`composer.json`) |
| Assertions | Pest, Laravel, Livewire, Pest browser plugins | `tests/Pest.php`, `composer.json` |
| Mock library | Mockery | ^1.6 (`composer.json`) |
| Coverage | Pest coverage and type coverage | minimum 90% line coverage and 100% type coverage (`composer.json`) |
| Static analysis | Larastan/PHPStan | ^3.0 (`phpstan.neon`) |
| Browser driver | Playwright | ^1.62.0 (`package.json`) |

### External integrations

| System | Client wiring |
|---|---|
| Redis | Predis ^3.0, Laravel queues/cache, Horizon ^5.48 |
| Discord | Laravel HTTP client via `App\Support\Alerts\DiscordAlert` |
| Brevo | `getbrevo/brevo-php` ^5.0 and `App\Mail\BrevoTransport` |
| Amazon S3 | `league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3` ^3.29.0 |
| ViaCEP/CNPJ | Application service classes under `app/Services` |
| Browser rendering | Browsershot ^5.0, Puppeteer ^25.1.0, Playwright ^1.62.0 |
